name: Arni Psito   Roast Leg Of Lamb
instructions: Place lamb fat-side up in shallow roasting pan
Rub lamb with olive oil and lemon juice
Season with rosemary , thyme , oregano , salt , pepper and garlic
Place in oven , reduce heat to 350f and rost lamb for 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours , or until internal temperature reaches 175-180f
To add the optional potates , about 40 minutes before lamb is done , peel and quarter 6 large potatoes and place them around the lamb
Sprinkle with additional lemon juice , salt , pepper and oregano to taste
After 20 minutes of baking , turn potatoes over to brown other side
Continue roasting until potatoes pierce easily with a fork
Let lamb stand 20 minutes before carving
